question: Where should the hrīṃ-trīṃ-huṃ obeisance formula to Ugrā be placed?
premises: The formula consists of hrīṃ, trīṃ, huṃ and obeisance.
The specified location is the forehead.
inference: One should also place the hrīṃ-trīṃ-huṃ obeisance formula to Ugrā on the forehead.
plain_english: One should also place hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ, obeisance to Ugrā, on the forehead.
